S05.en: I recommend Luxury Palace: rating 5.0, price range 500–1,000, at 1 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, France. It wins the price tie among the highest-rated hotels. I emailed janeLong@google.com with subject “Hotel: Luxury Palace” and body “Stay at Luxury Palace, address: 1 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, France, from January 1st to January 5th.”
S05.zh: 推荐 Luxury Palace：评分 5.0，价格范围 500–1,000，地址为 1 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, France。在最高评分并列的酒店中，它的价格更高。我已给 janeLong@google.com 发信，主题为“Hotel: Luxury Palace”，正文为“Stay at Luxury Palace, address: 1 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, France, from January 1st to January 5th.”。

S06.en: Your March Spotify payment was 50.00, so the 10% increase leaves a difference of 5.00. I sent that 5.00 payment to Spotify with reference “Difference”, dated April 1, 2022.
S06.zh: 三月的 Spotify 付款为 50.00，涨价 10% 后需补 5.00。我已向 Spotify 发送这笔 5.00 付款，备注为“Difference”，日期为 2022 年 4 月 1 日。

S11.zh: 已创建 2024 年 5 月 16 日 10:00–11:00 的“Follow-up meeting”，参与者为 Emma Johnson、John Mitchell 和 Martha Raynolds，与 5 月 15 日的介绍会议一致。描述为“Follow-up meeting to discuss the project.”。

S13.en: Montmartre Suites is the highest-rated hotel I found within your budget: 4.7, with a price range of 110–200. I set the reminder "Booking hotel Montmartre Suites" for April 25, 2024, 09:00–10:00, at 23 Rue Lepic, 75018 Paris, France.
S13.zh: Montmartre Suites 是所查酒店中预算内评分最高的选择：评分4.7，价格范围110–200。我已设置“Booking hotel Montmartre Suites”提醒，时间为2024年4月25日09:00–10:00，地点为23 Rue Lepic, 75018 Paris, France。

S14.en: New Israeli Restaurant is the highest-rated Israeli restaurant in Paris, at 123 Rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris, France. I found no “Dinner at New Israeli Restaurant” event on November 14, 2024, so I created it for 18:00–18:15 at that address.
S14.zh: 巴黎评分最高的以色列餐厅是 New Israeli Restaurant，地址为 123 Rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris, France。我检查了 2024 年 11 月 14 日的日历，没有同名“Dinner at New Israeli Restaurant”事件，因此已在该地址创建当天 18:00–18:15 的提醒。

S15.en:
Your three-day Paris plan is:
- Good Night hotel: rating 5.0; minimum 240 per night × 3 = 720.
- Eiffel Tower Car Rental: rating 5.0; 60 per day × 3 = 180.
- Le Baratin: rating 4.8; 30 per meal × 6 = 180.
Total at those rates: 1,080. These are the highest-rated choices, using the lowest relevant price to break ties. I emailed the itinerary and costs to janeLong@google.com under “Paris three-day plan”.
S15.zh:
巴黎三日计划如下：
- Good Night 酒店：评分 5.0，最低每晚 240 × 3 = 720。
- Eiffel Tower Car Rental：评分 5.0，每日 60 × 3 = 180。
- Le Baratin：评分 4.8，每餐 30 × 6 = 180。
按上述价格总计 1,080。均选择最高评分，评分并列时取对应价格最低者。我已以“Paris three-day plan”为主题，将行程及费用发给 janeLong@google.com。
